title: Country Law Repo API
text: For a US Client (Private project and not accessible publicly)
description: An API service that powers the Admin Portal for US clients. It centralizes and manages data related to patents, trademarks, and other intellectual property. The API processes requests, applications, official fees, and jurisdiction-specific rules to support individuals or organizations applying for IP protection in different countries. Built with .NET Core and Entity Framework for secure, scalable, and structured access to legal content.

title: Admin Portal

The portal interacts with the Country Law Repo API to handle applications, fee calculations, jurisdiction rules, and workflow processing. Designed to streamline operations for IP administrators handling country-specific regulations and submissions.

title: Semantic Search API
description: A .NET 8 Web API demonstrating semantic search using vector embeddings from Hugging Face's free inference API. This API allows you to search through text documents using semantic similarity instead of traditional keyword matching - for example, search for 'billionaire superhero' and find documents about Iron Man/Tony Stark, or 'animated ocean movie' to find Finding Nemo. The system converts text into 384-dimensional vectors using the sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 model, then finds similar documents by computing cosine similarity. Built with ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and SQL Server, featuring automatic seeding of 23 sample documents, retry logic for API calls, diagnostic endpoints, and a simple HTML/JS frontend for testing.
tech: .NET 8, C#, Vector Search, Hugging Face API
highlights: Implements semantic search using 384-dimensional vector embeddings
Cosine similarity ranking for intelligent document retrieval
Auto-seeding with 23 sample documents (tech docs, movies, concepts)
Retry logic with fallback for API resilience
Diagnostic endpoints for embedding verification and database reseeding
Simple HTML/JS frontend for testing and demonstration
features: Search by meaning rather than exact keyword matches
Automatic database seeding on first run
Rate limiting handling for free tier API
